---
name: refactor-code
description: Refactor existing code to improve maintainability, readability and performance while preserving existing business behavior and public contracts. Use when improving existing implementations.
---

# Code Refactoring Skill

## Objective

Improve code quality without changing existing business behavior.

## Instructions

1. Understand the existing implementation.
2. Identify code smells and duplication.
3. Identify unnecessary complexity.
4. Check existing test coverage.
5. Propose a minimal refactoring plan.
6. Refactor incrementally.
7. Preserve existing public contracts.
8. Run regression tests.
9. Review the complete git diff.

## Restrictions

- Do not change business behavior.
- Do not introduce unnecessary design patterns.
- Do not refactor unrelated modules.
- Do not remove existing tests.
- Avoid large-scale changes in a single operation.

## Expected Output

### 1. Refactoring Objective
### 2. Problems Identified
### 3. Changes Made
### 4. Tests Executed
### 5. Behavior Compatibility
### 6. Remaining Improvements
